violated_contract: A bounded periodic observer must refresh within its declared freshness budget even while unrelated maintenance remains in flight. Sampling only inside a maintenance pass inherits that pass's unbounded duration and can publish an expired observation.
canonical_prevention: Supervise the observer on its own interruptible timer and an executor independent of long maintenance, retaining the existing leader election, overlap coalescing, query budget and stale-sample suppression. Exercise the real sampler with maintenance deliberately stalled and a deterministic clock advancing beyond the freshness budget.
